customer: how much do u charge for ac service? i have 2 splits
reply: AC general service is Rs 3,000 per unit. You can book the visit on WhatsApp.

customer: My fridge is not cooling properly, do you repair fridges also?
reply: Yes, we repair fridges, and the rate is shared after checking. The visit charge is Rs 1,500, which is adjusted in the bill if you go ahead with the repair.

customer: Can a technician come on Sunday? Thats the only day I'm home
reply: On Sunday we only do emergency visits, for Rs 1,000 extra. Regular visits are Monday to Saturday, 9am to 7pm.

customer: do you come to Kotri? my parents AC needs installation
reply: Sorry, our service area is only Hyderabad city and Qasimabad. AC installation there is Rs 4,500.

customer: Do you repair the PCB board of inverter ACs? What would it cost roughly
reply: The checking visit is Rs 1,500, but our policy does not cover PCB board repair rates. Our team will contact you shortly.

customer: do you sell new ac units too or only repair?
reply: We do AC service, gas refill and installation for Rs 4,500, but we don't have information about selling AC units. Our team will contact you shortly.
